Well, I have nothing to write about, when I was young, mischievous and had a lot of free time, I hung out in a computer club, then they played NFS: Hot Pursuit/GTA2/Rainbow Six/WarCraft2/StarCraft en masse and out of the corner of my eye I saw some guys playing Quake while drinking beer, drawing a tournament table on a piece of paper, it was Arion (I think Sergey), Flash (also Sergey), Hunter (Dima), and a couple more guys, because I found out that it was x3m Slavik and I don’t even remember the last one, my memory is failing me, I asked what game it was, whether I could play with them, they copied the game over the network, they roasted me in all the cracks and said that I could also play via the Internet (then it was the time of Fidonet, they were sitting on 56k modems and occupied the phone line). (c) xek
